assessment: Explicit source-path review for the dependency upgrade, retaining the original 2026-11-29 expiry and managed-default-server-DTLS scope. mediasoup 0.29.0 still creates an in-process Rust thread and directly calls mediasoup_worker_run; worker/utils.rs is unchanged from 0.27.0. The 0.19.0 DTLS source delta changes timer labels, signed timestamps and application-data receive timestamps while retaining OpenSSL SSL/BIO calls. The maintained authenticated-close, fingerprint and SRTP validation patches remain present. First-party production changes replace deprecated atomic calls and widen configuration inputs/saturate worker estimates at the existing application bitrate boundary; they introduce no subprocess, dynamic-loader, iconv or gconv call. The authenticated native inventory updates libuv and unordered_dense while retaining static OpenSSL 3.5.9, no-module/no-engine options and the same OpenSSL installer. The Cargo dependency graph and all source identities are rebound to the reviewed upgrade; optional load-test clients are not in the production image. The built-in files/dns NSS and restricted loader profile are unchanged. This assessment covers the intended production execution path, not every unused dependency API, engine-provided init, administrator-selected programs or arbitrary post-deployment mutation. Actual archive/final-binary identities, runtime restrictions and image findings remain independently enforced; changed source or profile bytes require fresh review.
